# Express Shipping Cost

Great question! **Express shipping costs $14.95**, and it's never free—even for Leafy Plus members.

Here's what you get with Express:

| Zone | Delivery Time |
|---|---|
| **Zone 1** (under 300 miles) | Next business day |
| **Zone 2** (300–1,000 miles) | 2 business days |
| **Zone 3** (over 1,000 miles, remote/island) | Not available |

**Note:** Express is only available for non-living items (pots, tools, soil, etc.) and non-XL plants. XL plants (usually over 4 ft) ship Standard only with a $20 handling fee.

If you have a specific order in mind or want to know what zone you're in, I'm happy to help! 🌿
